content.title: Sting | News
content.text: Mar 20, 2026 We are delighted to announce that Sting has added second concerts in both Nashville and Pittsburgh during his North American tour this fall. The shows are at The Truth in Nashville, TN on October 20 and at Citizens Live at The Wylie in Pittsburgh, PA on November 7. Tickets go on presale to Sting.com members on Wednesday, March 25 at 10am local and on general sale on Friday, March 27... Mar 19, 2026 Villa d’Este announces its most anticipated summer event - Sting in concert in the Mosaic Garden on 9 August 2026. At Villa d’Este, Lake Como and its monumental gardens become a stage, where history resonates and music intertwines with beauty. It is in this timeless setting that, on 9 August 2026, world-renowed artist, Sting will offer the Grand Hotel’s guests an evening destined to become a treasured memory... Mar 16, 2026 We are delighted to announce that Sting has added a further concert to his North American tour this fall on the highly revered “STING 3.0” World Tour, presented by the Cherrytree Music Company and Live Nation. The show is at The Truth in Nashville, TN on October 19. Tickets go on presale to Sting.com members on Wednesday, March 18 at 10am local and on general sale on March 20 at 10am local... Mar 16, 2026 We are delighted to announce that Sting has added a further concert to his North American tour this fall on the highly revered “STING 3.0” World Tour, presented by the Cherrytree Music Company and Live Nation. The show is at Citizens Live at The Wylie in Pittsburgh, PA on November 6. Tickets go on presale to Sting.com members on Wednesday, March 18 at 10am local and on general sale on March 20 at 10am local... Mar 09, 2026 We are delighted to announce that Sting has added second concerts on the highly revered “STING 3.0” World Tour, presented by the Cherrytree Music Company and Live Nation in Minneapolis (Oct 14), Indianapolis (Oct 23) and Akron (Nov 2) and a fourth show in Montreal (Oct 30). Tickets go on presale to Sting.com members from 10am (local time) on Tuesday March 10 (Wed, Mar 11 for Montreal) with tickets going on general sale from Friday, March 13 at 10am (local time)... Mar 05, 2026 During his time in Amsterdam, ARTE captured Sting’s breathtaking performance at the Rijksmuseum, creating a stunning live film that will premiere on ARTE’s VOD platform on March 5 before broadcasting across the network in Germany and France on March 27. The performance will also receive a physical release on CD and vinyl, titled Sting – The Night Watch: Live at the Rijksmuseum, with pre-orders launching March 5 ahead of the June 26 release... Mar 04, 2026 Today, 17-time GRAMMY® Award-winning artist and Rock and Roll Hall of Fame® Inductee Sting, managed by Martin Kierszenbaum/ Cherrytree Music Company, celebrates the 30th anniversary of his GRAMMY® Award-nominated and Platinum-Certified fifth full-length solo album, Mercury Falling, with the release of a new Digital-Only special Expanded Edition available on all streaming platforms via UMe... Mar 04, 2026 I recently had the privilege of performing at the legendary @rijksmuseum in Amsterdam for Arte’s Sounds Like Art concert series, and I can’t wait for you to see it. The episode premieres this Thursday, 5 March on Arte’s YouTube Channel and Arte.tv - Sting Mar 02, 2026 The newly announced 2026 dates will begin in Vancouver, BC, with a two-night run at Queen Elizabeth Theatre on October 5th and 6th before continuing through Seattle, Minneapolis, Rockford, St. Louis, Indianapolis, Montreal, Akron, Cincinnati, Wallingford, Brooklyn, and Tampa, with performances in Nashville and Pittsburgh to be announced soon... Feb 28, 2026 We are delighted to announce that Sting has added a further European concert in 2026 on the highly revered “STING 3.0” World Tour, presented by the Cherrytree Music Company and Live Nation. The show is at Jazz a L’Hospitalet in Narbonne, France on July 22. Tickets are available now via the tour page...
